result.title: Error Correction in Trained TTT Layers
result.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures. Code and saved results included as ancillary material and at https://github.com/aliceyh7/ttt-error-correction
result.summary: Test-time-training (TTT) layers update fast-weight memory while processing an input sequence. A gradient-based update, however, does not by itself establish how the memory revises an existing association. We study the structure and empirical role of prediction-derived updates in released TTT implementations. For dot-product objectives, we characterize the absence of a prediction-error residual and establish conditions under which inner-loop ascent and descent are equivalent after reparameterization. For the LayerNorm-based squared-error objective used by TTT-Linear and TTT-MLP, we derive the inner gradient and identify a prediction-derived component that cancels at the released initialization in the zero-epsilon limit. We then measure the full normalized prediction's contribution on three trained checkpoints. Removing this contribution while retaining the LayerNorm Jacobian gives a mean gradient norm ratio of 0.25 to 0.32 across the models. On 100,303 tokens from War and Peace, the same intervention with local per-token norm matching raises perplexity by 2.8-2.9% on TTT-Linear-760M and 1.3B, whereas freezing all fast-weight updates raises it by factors of 4.2-4.5. Separate synthetic tests illustrate the dependence of plain delta-rule overwriting on step size. The results distinguish a prediction-derived update from its behavioral value and show why implementation analysis and live interventions are both needed to assess test-time memory.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析已发布 TTT 层中由预测误差驱动的 fast-weight 更新，推导 dot-product 目标下缺失误差残差的条件与 LayerNorm 平方误差目标的内层梯度，并在三个训练好的 checkpoint 上用移除预测分量、冻结更新等干预测量其对困惑度的贡献。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「拆出内部更新分量并结合逐 token 范数匹配的干预来量化状态贡献」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何被更新、以及答案对 latent 内容的依赖与贡献分配提供可供核查的分析线索。
